name: Anime industry market by segment, including merchandise
rows_note: One row per year, 2002 to 2024, billion yen
source: Association of Japanese Animations (AJA), Anime Industry Report summaries 2021, 2024 and 2025
snapshot: 2002-2016 from the 2021 summary, 2017-2023 from the 2024 summary, 2024 from the 2025 summary
prepared: AJA publishes these as PDF charts, not CSV, so the figures were transcribed into CSV. Every row's segments add up to the published total.
